statements.t: We believe that our progress with differentiated liver-targeted programs and targeted delivery to extrahepatic tissues positions us to advance our mission of delivering life-changing treatments to patients with unmet medical needs.”

Determination has been made to not evaluate higher doses after the third dose cohort (400 mg) in the ongoing Phase 1 trial, and the Company intends to evaluate higher doses in its planned Phase 2 clinical trial.

The Company expects its existing cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments, together with those proceeds, to fund its projected operating expenses and capital expenditure requirements into 2030.
